info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Inventory Distribution Distribution-spec
info.description: The Product Inventory Distribution API enables businesses to manage and distribute product inventory across various channels effectively. This endpoint allows users to initiate the creation of distribution records, ensuring accurate tracking and allocation of inventory. Typical consumers include inventory managers and retail coordinators, who rely on this functionality to streamline operations and enhance product availability. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve their distribution strategies and respond agilely to market demands.

post.summary: Create a distribution for channel-specific product inventory.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new distribution for channel-specific product inventory. You can specify the details of the distribution in the request body. This is essential for managing how products are distributed across different channels.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update product inventory distributions specific to a channel. It expects a JSON object describing the distribution details, including relevant identifiers, quantities, and any other necessary metadata.

202.description: The request is accepted and is being processed asynchronously.
